g.text: Half-duplex TTL: 1G126 drives DATA from UART2_TX (OE=DXL_DIR high), 1G125 reads DATA into UART2_RX (/OE=DXL_DIR low). R310 pulls DXL_DIR low at boot so the board listens. One bus, two EH sockets, no RS485.

g.desc: Half-duplex TTL: 1G126 drives DATA from UART2_TX (OE=DXL_DIR high), 1G125 reads DATA into UART2_RX (/OE=DXL_DIR low). R310 pulls DXL_DIR low at boot so the board listens. One bus, two EH sockets, no RS485.

g.text: EH pin order: 1=GND, 2=VBAT, 3=DATA. R309 (0R) is the battery-to-servo branch. UART2 is the boot console until disabled in software.

g.desc: EH pin order: 1=GND, 2=VBAT, 3=DATA. R309 (0R) is the battery-to-servo branch. UART2 is the boot console until disabled in software.
